text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGING: elevated decode errors and garbled completions observed for model redwood-3b-v2 in us-west-2. Error rate spike ~12% across prod traffic. Alert: inference_errors > 5% for 3m.

sam_oncall: I'm on it. Pulling canary dashboard now. Anyone seeing matching logs?

priya_sre: seeing same. Canary hosts show high 500s from runtime; traces show tokenizer mismatch warnings on startup: "vocab offset != expected".

irene_ml: quick context — we pushed weightmap rotation this morning (weight-mapper v2.1) and flipped the 'enable-weight-rotation' flag at 09:12. Canary passed unit checks but we saw a small diff on QA.

sam_oncall: could be weight-to-tokenizer alignment issue. Is there a recent tokenizer config deploy?

deploy-bot: deploy:release/rdw-weightmap-2026-03-17 promoted to canary at 09:12 by @irene_ml. Artifact: weightset-20260317-v3. Tokenizer config: token-config-20260312 (pinned).

david_prod: customers calling in. Support triage says a few completions contain garbled tokens and punctuation, some completions truncated mid-sentence. Impact: chat features degraded for ~4% of requests for a subset of tenants.

support_pager: flagging two enterprise customers (acme-inc, apexhealth) reporting high error counts. Putting them on incident watch.

priya_sre: creating short-lived incident channel for coordination. For now: stop rollout, set feature flag to prevent promotion to prod. Sam, can you flip the kill-switch?

sam_oncall: flipping feature flag now: `curl -X POST https://internal.flags/api/flip -d '{"flag":"enable-weight-rotation","value":false}'`

sam_oncall: response 200. Rolling back canary promotion and draining canary nodes. Kicking off graceful rollback: `rdwctl rollout revert --target canary --artifact weightset-20260314-v7`

deploy-bot: rollback job started (job id jf-4492). Draining canary nodes, re-routing traffic to baseline.

irene_ml: curious — if we rolled weightset but tokenizer pinned older, mismatch suggests mapping change in weightset metadata (vocab_shift: +3). Need to verify manifest signing.

priya_sre: canary error rate dropping to ~1.2% after rollback initiated. Still monitoring.

david_prod: starting coordinated customer notification draft. No data exfil, just degraded outputs.

support_pager: notified acme-inc support lead, started temporary mitigation (client-side retry/backoff guidance).

sam_oncall: logs from one canary node: `WARN tokenizer: token id out of range at decode pos 42` and `ERROR runtime: KV cache mismatch shape` — collecting heap and nvprof.

irene_ml: investigating weightset metadata: comparing checksums and token-to-id mapping between v3 and baseline v7. Quick diff shows the new weightset shipped with a stale tokenizer-index mapping file (token_index.json) that wasn't updated in the release pipeline. That explains vocab offset drift.

priya_sre: confirm: root cause likely release pipeline omission (packaging step skipped token_index update). Next steps: hold all rollouts, revert canary fully to baseline, revoke artifact alias for weightset-20260317-v3, and create hotfix weightset with corrected token_index.

sam_oncall: can we do expedited hotfix build? Irene, can you assemble corrected weight artifact?

irene_ml: yes. Building hotpatch now — will validate token-index and run small decode tests. ETA ~25m.

deploy-bot: canary traffic back to baseline at 09:36, error rate back to 0.3% on canary slice. Prod routing unchanged (we didn't promote).

david_prod: coordinating go/no-go with legal/comms for customer message.

support_pager: customers updated: short note sent, we offered priority queue and rollback timeline.

priya_sre: action items captured: 1) irene to produce hotpatch with verified token_index (done by 10:05), 2) CI pipeline gating change to verify token_index presence before artifact alias promotion, 3) postmortem and follow-up.

irene_ml: hotpatch artifact built, running internal decode smoke tests. Tests passing locally. Uploading as weightset-20260317-v3-hotfix.

sam_oncall: schedule a conservative canary (1% traffic) if we promote. Also enable extra logging and decode assertions for the next 2 hours.

david_prod: approve canary once smoke looks good and SLOs stable for 10m. Notify customers before any broader rollout.

deploy-bot: initiating hotfix canary promotion (artifact weightset-20260317-v3-hotfix) at 09:57. Canary slice 1%.

priya_sre: monitoring: no tokenizer warnings, error rate stable at baseline. Increasing to 5% after 10m of stability.

support_pager: customers confirmed better behavior on our end.

sam_oncall: increasing observability retention for canary to 1h. Leaving flag flipped off for full rollout until postmortem.

priya_sre: incident triage concl: mitigation successful, initial root cause packaging omission. Booking postmortem for 2026-03-18 16:00 PDT. Assigning owners: packaging pipeline (priya_sre), release engineering (irene_ml), deploy automation tests (sam_oncall), communications (david_prod).

incident-bot: Incident resolved: Severity: SEV-2. Duration: 45m. Primary mitigation: rollback to baseline + hotpatch canary. Postmortem scheduled. :white_check_mark:
